scope: One 3840×2160 held-out Profile 8.1 carrier, CM2.9, neutral target-1 creative controls. Target 100 cd/m², black 0.005 cd/m², BT.709. All comparisons use absolute BT.2020/PQ RGB16LE and the public full-raster BT.2124 metric.
controls: Replayed the shot's quantized analysis, mastering metadata and neutral trims using the scalar model and the packaged Vulkan provider.
Uploaded the reference RGB through RGBA32F and read it back. All 49,766,400 bytes matched.
Captured the normal FFmpeg callback's input and output on Intel Vulkan. The instrumented final export reproduced the ordinary export byte for byte.
Serialized the captured input to TIFF with a byte-exact readback. The official processor used the same metadata, target and output encoding for the original and captured inputs.
normal_input: Decoded limited-range 10-bit HEVC, actual mapper input RGBA16F. The independent reference carrier converted the same 4:2:0 planes to RGB with zscale. The normal mapper returned RGBA32F.
interpretation: With identical RGB inputs, the CPU and GPU mapping implementations agree closely on this neutral scene. Independent YUV-to-RGB reconstruction accounts for a sizeable part of the earlier pipeline disagreement. A residual remains against the official base grade even after matching the mapper input. The distances do not add linearly.
limits: One scene and one neutral trim/target. This comparison does not identify which reconstruction is preferable, validate emitted light or establish a correction for other material.
